title: Glowing envelope
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Envelope body -->
  <rect x="12" y="28" width="76" height="50" rx="4" ry="4" fill="#FFE066"/>
  <!-- Envelope flap (triangle) -->
  <polygon points="12,28 50,58 88,28" fill="#FFB347"/>
  <!-- Flap edge highlight -->
  <polygon points="16,30 50,55 84,30" fill="#FFD966"/>
  <!-- Bottom fold lines -->
  <line x1="12" y1="78" x2="38" y2="54" stroke="#F0C040" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="88" y1="78" x2="62" y2="54" stroke="#F0C040" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Glow around envelope -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="53" rx="42" ry="32" fill="#FFE066" opacity="0.15"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="53" rx="36" ry="27" fill="#FFE066" opacity="0.1"/>
  <!-- Small sparkles -->
  <circle cx="20" cy="20" r="2" fill="#FFF5B0"/>
  <circle cx="80" cy="18" r="1.5" fill="#FFF5B0"/>
  <circle cx="85" cy="65" r="1.5" fill="#FFF5B0"/>
  <circle cx="15" cy="70" r="2" fill="#FFF5B0"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="14" r="1.8" fill="#FFF5B0"/>
  <!-- Heart seal on flap -->
  <path d="M50 48 C46 43, 40 44, 40 49 C40 54, 50 58, 50 58 C50 58, 60 54, 60 49 C60 44, 54 43, 50 48 Z" fill="#FF6B6B"/>
</svg>
